subject.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends

question: Should this PR land the Signal-only `replyToId` alias plus bounded Signal reply-author persistence as the durable native quote contract now?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-supported, but automation should not accept the compatibility, local sender-retention, and native quote delivery behavior tradeoffs on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept the narrow Signal contract
options.body: Merge after maintainer review accepts the Signal-only alias and bounded reply-author lookup as the intended durable native reply behavior.

options.title: Require live Signal smoke first
options.body: Hold merge until a maintainer-run Signal account/device test shows a durable reply rendering as a native quote.

options.title: Defer to broader quote work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the older broad bidirectional quote branch to define the permanent contract instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow Signal contract
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review accepts the Signal-only alias and bounded reply-author lookup as the intended durable native reply behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged Signal native quote foundation and this follow-up branch, so they are the clearest owner for accepting or revising the contract.
